title: refactor-ci-modernize-build-matrix-cache-parallelism
author: Sofia Chen
description: Modernize CI build matrix and cache keys to reduce redundant builds, improve cache hit rate, and enable safer parallelism. Motivation: recent increases in CI minutes and flaky parallel runs uncovered that matrix axes were over-provisioned and cache keys were too granular, leading to missed cache hits and long queue times for PR-driven builds. This PR: 1) consolidates Node versions into a single tested matrix with stratified jobs for lint/test/build; 2) introduces a deterministic cache key scheme (repo+package-lock-hash+matrix-seed) to improve hit rate across dependent workflows; 3) splits long running heavy integration jobs into gated parallel shards with deterministic ordering to reduce wall-clock time while preserving reproducibility; 4) centralizes common steps into action templates and small helper scripts to reduce duplication; 5) updates release automation workflow hygiene to avoid redundant release workflow triggers on documentation-only changes. Includes a short migration note for repo maintainers. Checklist: - [x] update workflows and action templates - [x] add migration notes and docs - [x] validate cache key compatibility with legacy workflows - [x] run canary against sample PRs and internal repo. Related: ENG-1423 (CI cost savings), ENG-1981 (flake mitigation).
